user_intent: Economic condition item labels and their combinations, NOT a new market prediction algorithm; outcome lookup is separate

definitions.label_scope: economic conditions; K01 etc inputs, not outcomes
definitions.outcome_scope: XAU direction/size/time/path observed after source's event timestamp; never use outcomes for asof inputs
definitions.surprise_definition: first-release actual vs pre-release market consensus; NOT high/low absolute macro levels
definitions.prior_release_context: latest other-kind release strictly earlier than trigger, no more than 45 days old, does not pretend simultaneous release
definitions.unverified_first_print: actual/consensus historical archive vintage has not been independently certified; labels are retrospective research only
definitions.separation_of_roles: K condition labels independent of legacy ETKI-05 E01-E05 mechanism-family names and OGREN-03 ORG01-ORG12
definitions.risk_of_selection: condition combinations examined after outcomes; no independent blinded test or calibrated probabilities
definitions.banks_fee: 0.8% each side; lookup does not authorize trade
definitions.magnitude_threshold: 1% in 4 hours illustrative; NOT learned regime-scaled definition of LARGE

future_testing: test each K-combination with true untouched newer events
use per-horizon volatility-normalized size and negative controls
do not insert 2026 future knowledge into 2023 blind walk-forward

additional_source_evidence.join: ts and etype exact to 85 macro csv: 69 matched CPI/NFP, 68 have valid 4h XAU result
additional_source_evidence.critical_scope: K06/K07/K16-K19 are research-proxy archived surprises, not independently authenticated live availability or bank trading signal

global_event_rules.warning: Official release happened does not imply hawkish, bearish gold or alpha. Directional claims require as-of economic surprise and cross-market validation.
global_event_rules.rule_engine_purpose: event/label/ORG candidates only, NO direct S1 S2 S3 order or alpha
